prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System:Regional Flow Platform=Cedarbell;airports:Meridian International Airport,Harbor East Airport,North Valley Airport,Lakeside Regional Airport,Southport Airport. Aliases:Airline Operations Coordinator=Saffron;Regional Flow Manager=Copperfin;Demand Prediction Service=Marlinstone;Weather Ingest Gateway=Orchard;Airport CDM Portal=Foxglove;Tower Supervisor=Brindle;Ramp Control Lead=Quartzline;Slot Allocation Engine=Blueharbor;Slot Coordinator=Halcyon;Tower Sequence Manager=Ironleaf;Ramp Movement Board=Skylark;Alert Distribution Hub=Lantern;Departure Metering Service=Emberline;Arrival Regulation Console=Nightjar(help-only);Contingency Operations Console=Silverpine(exercises/live-fallback). Airline Operations Centre→Airline Interface Adapter→Flight Data Exchange:Flight Intent Message;invalid→reason-codes;material-intents supersede schedules;changes require messages. Cedarbell normalizes Airport Capacity Plan;Capacity Assessment Module updates Airport Acceptance Rate/constraints;allocation-time correlation mandatory. Blueharbor→Adapter/Foxglove:Calculated Takeoff Time,Target Off Block Time,arrival-opportunities;freeze→Pushback Window Token;inside-freeze changes require reason-code/Copperfin-review visibility. Capacity>preferences;safety/emergency/humanitarian/national-obligation>commercial>discretionary;Ground Delay Program equity;justify changes;stands≠airspace-override. Orchard validates weather/provenance/overrides;Storm Cell Snapshot confidence/degradation/provisional-capacity visible;Meteorology Briefing Officer verifies. East Apron Sensor/West Apron Sensor→Skylark→Surface Surveillance Adapter→Foxglove:movements/milestones≤5s;validated-occupancy/equipment-status→Skylark/Ironleaf;Ironleaf/Skylark actual-milestones independently verify slots;surface-evidence retained for disputes/audits. Quartzline→Blueharbor:Stand Tow Request Form;Brindle/Airport Duty Manager resolve-conflicts;Runway Inspection Note precedes endorsement;North Runway Meter/South Runway Meter receive-capacities. Saffron confirms-plans/deferrals/revised-intents;Brindle distinguishes-holds;Handling Resource Planner grades-severity/suppresses-recovery-duplicates;Ground Handling Dispatcher→Towbar;Aircraft Operator Representative supplies-crew-legality. Common Situation Display:staff-readable

New part:
S819: The Meteorology Briefing Officer shall own operational weather classification inputs accepted by the Weather Ingest Gateway.
S820: The Airline Operations Coordinator shall be accountable for airline-supplied schedule intent, readiness status, and Target Off Block Time updates submitted through approved interfaces.
S821: Each owned data element shall have a defined business meaning, allowed value range, update authority, retention class, and escalation contact.
S822: Freshness indicators shall be displayed on the Common Situation Display wherever stale data could affect sequencing, metering, regulation, or resource allocation decisions.
S823: The freshness indicator shall include the time of last accepted update, the maximum permitted age, and a visual state that distinguishes current, aging, stale, and unavailable data.
S824: The Time Synchronization Service shall provide the common time basis used for freshness calculations across the Regional Flow Platform.
S825: The Demand Prediction Service, Capacity Assessment Module, Slot Allocation Engine, and Departure Metering Service shall reject data that lacks a trusted timestamp.
S826: Validation rules shall include schema checks, mandatory field checks, code set checks, temporal sequence checks, and operational plausibility checks.
S827: The Flight Data Exchange shall validate Flight Intent Message content before the data is made available for operational use.
S828: The Surface Surveillance Adapter shall apply position quality checks and shall mark uncertain observations before they are used by surface decision functions.
S829: The Airline Interface Adapter shall apply carrier-specific format checks while preserving the common operational meaning required by the Regional Flow Platform.
S830: The Handling Resource Planner shall validate resource quantities, task timing, and allocation identifiers against active operational reference data.
S831: The Business Rules Registry shall hold the current validation thresholds, allowable reason codes, and exception rules approved for Normal Operations, Adverse Weather Mode, Capacity Reduction State, Recovery Phase, and Contingency Fallback State.
S832: When a discrepancy is detected, the affected component shall mark the data as disputed and shall preserve the prior accepted value until an authorized correction is available.
S833: The Data Governance Steward shall coordinate discrepancy resolution with the responsible operational owner and shall record the disposition in the Audit Event Ledger.
S834: Urgent discrepancies that could change a metering, arrival regulation, or slot allocation decision shall be raised through the Alert Distribution Hub and reviewed in the Digital Briefing Room.
S835: The System Support Engineer shall investigate technical causes of missing, delayed, duplicated, or transformed records and shall provide evidence needed for stewardship decisions.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
